objective: Add request ids, JSON access logs, and a metrics page
success_conditions: A chat response returns an X-Request-Id header
A caller-supplied request id returns that same id
An access log line returns the request id and the status and leaves out the submitted message text
GET /metrics returns a request counter that is higher after a chat request
